decisive_items: apex of the heart located at the right side of the chest
right atrium and right ventricle laid on the left side and the left atrium and left ventricle on the right side with its apex directed to the right
response.rationale: R2 is supported by the physical examination and imaging findings, which show the heart on the right side and the atria and ventricles in a reversed arrangement, indicating dextrocardia with situs inversus. R1 is supported by the ECG findings, but the physical examination and imaging findings take precedence in this case.

rejected.why: C1 is an extension of R2, but it is not necessary to specify 'totalis' in this case, as the diagnosis of dextrocardia with situs inversus is already supported by the findings.
